title: The Lost Bicycle
summary: A girl loses her new bicycle at the market and finds help from a kind old neighbour.

cover.scene: Flat 2D illustration: Ama standing next to an empty bicycle rack at a busy street market, fruit stalls behind her, no text

chapters.title: Where Is My Bicycle?
sentences: On Saturday morning, Ama rode her new bicycle to the market.
She wanted to buy some fruit for her mother.
The market was full of people, so she parked her bicycle near the gate.
She was away for only ten minutes.
When she came back, the bicycle was not there.
Ama felt very sad and a little angry.
She looked in every street near the market.
Then she asked a woman who sold flowers.
"Did you see a red bicycle?" Ama asked.
"No, I am sorry," the woman said, "but you should call the police."

quiz.q: Why did Ama go to the market?
options: To buy fruit for her mother
quiz.explain: She wanted to buy some fruit for her mother.

quiz.q: Where did Ama leave her bicycle?
quiz.explain: She parked it near the gate of the market.

quiz.q: What did the flower seller advise?
quiz.explain: The woman said Ama should call the police.

chapters.title: A Kind Neighbour
sentences: Ama walked home slowly and told her father the sad news.
"Let us call the police together," he said.
Just then, their old neighbour, Mr Lopez, knocked on the door.
He was holding a red bicycle in his hand.
"I saw a boy take this from the market," he said.
"I followed him, and he left it in the street."
Ama was so happy that she gave Mr Lopez a big hug.
Her father thanked him many times.
The next day, Ama bought a strong lock for her bicycle.
She also brought a basket of fruit to her kind neighbour.

quiz.explain: Their neighbour, Mr Lopez, found the bicycle and brought it back.

quiz.q: Where did Mr Lopez find the bicycle?
quiz.explain: The boy left it in the street after Mr Lopez followed him.

quiz.q: What did Ama do the next day?
options: She bought a lock and gave fruit to Mr Lopez
quiz.explain: She bought a strong lock and brought a basket of fruit to Mr Lopez.
